recognize_zh: kappa 原位雜交（ISH）中許多細胞的細胞質呈深藍黑色強陽性訊號，沿纖維血管區成片聚集，而同一病例的 lambda ISH 只有零星陽性；kappa 占絕對多數代表輕鏈限制（kappa restriction），支持脾臟邊緣區淋巴瘤的漿細胞分化為單株。
features: Numerous cells with strong dark blue-black cytoplasmic kappa mRNA signal
Positive cells have eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear rim of signal, consistent with plasma cells/plasmacytoid cells
Positive cells cluster in a band along a fibrovascular or trabecular region and scatter into adjacent tissue
Surrounding small lymphoid cells are negative with pale red counterstain
Interpretation of restriction requires comparison with the paired lambda ISH
describe_en: Kappa light-chain in situ hybridization in splenic tissue shows many cells with strong cytoplasmic signal, morphologically plasma cells, arranged in aggregates along a fibrovascular band and scattered in the surrounding parenchyma. The background small lymphoid cells lack signal. When compared with the paired lambda ISH, which shows only rare positive cells, the plasma cells demonstrate kappa light-chain restriction. Findings are consistent with a monotypic plasmacytic component in splenic marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Shows a mixture of kappa- and lambda-positive plasma cells with a ratio of roughly 2:1 rather than marked kappa predominance.
Also has monotypic plasma cells, but usually shows MYD88 L265P and an IgM paraprotein with less marginal-zone and micronodular white pulp pattern.
Consists of sheets of monotypic CD138+ plasma cells without an accompanying CD20+ small B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Nonspecific ISH background or trapped serum
ddx.vs: Background staining is diffuse and extracellular rather than crisp cytoplasmic signal in individual cells.
